info.title: Leadinfo
info.description:
Connect Leadinfo to your automated workflows to transform website visitors into actionable leads. This connector lets you seamlessly sync real-time company data, visitor behaviour, and contact information with your favourite CRM, ERP, and communication tools.

Automate lead assignments, trigger instant Slack or Teams notifications for hot prospects, and keep your sales pipeline up to date without manual entry. Turn anonymous traffic into growth opportunities with Leadinfo.
